text:
emily: kickoff for a short, focused nurture after launch. concept = a 3-email "mini-course" that teaches one thing per message and finishes with a bench/webinar invite. keep each email <100 words.

dan: segments? suggest: dev_clickers, trial_watchers, corp_admins. we'll size later.

vince: agree. dev_clickers = clicked docs or examples, trial_watchers = signed up but no usage, corp_admins = company domains flagged.

emily: cadence: E1 (day 0) orientation + micro-skill #1, E2 (day 4) micro-skill #2 + quick metric, E3 (day 9) webinar invite + next steps.

priya: subject options (E1): "Quick win: reduce latency in 2 steps" / "Start: 2 quick tips for faster inference". test on dev_clickers only.

dan: creative: E2 should include a tiny benchmark card (PNG) and a one-line callout: "50% lower per-token cost vs default" — need legal check on phrasing.

vince: technical snippet for devs (inline, small): ```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/run -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" -d '{"prompt":"hi"}'
```
put in E1 or E2?

emily: put in E2. E1 stays high-level. E2 include curl + 2-line example output.

priya: links: use utm_campaign=mini_course_launch and utm_content={segment}. webinar link = https://events.redwood.ai/benchmarks with utm_medium=email.

dan: send windows: dev_clickers Tue 9am PT, trial_watchers Thu 10am PT, corp_admins Mon 11am PT.

vince: rollout: phase A = dev_clickers ~3.5k. send E1 -> monitor opens 24h -> proceed. if E1 open < 13% swap subject and resend.

emily: owners: vince = segment export + csv drop, priya = subject + image, dan = send & suppression rules, me = copy + final review.

marketing-bot: reminder set: draft copy due Fri 11:59pm in #marketing. :calendar:

priya: small creative note: keep images <100KB, include alt text and plain-text fallback.

dan: i'll add suppression: exclude anyone with unsubscribe flag or internal domains.

emily: final ask: keep CTAs single per email and track demo_clicks + trial_starts + webinar_regs. next check-in here after phase A results. thanks! :rocket:
